events.name: The Rocky Horror Picture Show
events.description:
Join us at the historic Avalon Theatre as we celebrate the unforgettable legacy of legendary actor Tim Curry with an Interactive screening of The Rocky Horror Picture Show! 🎬✨

A gloriously outrageous celebration of music, madness, and unapologetic individuality, The Rocky Horror Picture Show follows sweethearts Brad and Janet as a wrong turn leads them to the mysterious mansion of Dr. Frank-N-Furter. What begins as a strange night quickly becomes an unforgettable journey into a world of wild characters, unforgettable songs, and fearless self-expression. 

Come dressed to impress, bring your best Rocky Horror spirit, and get ready for a night of cult-classic fun, music, and mayhem.  🖤 Let’s do the Time Warp again!
 
A PROP BAG IS INCLUDED WITH YOUR TICKET PRICE OF $25, which will include the following items: - Confetti, Newspaper, Water Gun, Gloves, Noisemakers, Popcorn, Toilet Paper, Party Hat, and Playing Cards.

NO OUTSIDE PROPS ARE ALLOWED INTO THE THEATRE BANNED ITEMS - Lighters, Candles, Or Any Fire - Any Food, Rice, Toast, Hot Dogs, Prunes

Rated R: 17+ age

Doors: 6:00 PM
Movie: 7:00 PM

events.name: U.S. Navy Band Commodores jazz ensemble
events.description:
For more than half a century, the U.S. Navy Band Commodores, the Navy's premier jazz ensemble, has delivered world-class jazz performances in support of the nation. Founded as a standalone unit in 1969, this 19-member ensemble comprises some of the finest musicians in the world and furthers the American jazz legacy through public concerts, national concert tours, ceremonial support, educational outreach and clinics and high-visibility protocol performances for the most senior military and civilian government officials.

events.name: Mountainfilm on Tour - Grand Junction
events.description:
Join us for an evening of inspiring and captivating films handpicked from the Mountainfilm festival in Telluride, Colorado.
Mountainfilm on Tour in Grand Junction will feature a collection of culturally rich, adventure-packed and inspiring documentary short films that align with Mountainfilm’s mission to use the power of film, art and ideas to inspire audiences to create a better world. 

Doors open for the event at 5:30pm for happy hour and a silent auction, and the show will kick off at 7pm.

Mountainfilm on Tour in Grand Junction is hosted by Western Colorado Alliance.
